pin.title: MEININGER Milano Garibaldi Opens
pin.description: A budget hotel and hostel hybrid in Milan’s Cenisio area, with private multi-bed family rooms, a guest kitchen, laundry and shared lounge spaces.
pin.address: Via Privata Giovanni Calvino 11, 20154 Milan, Italy
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: The operator’s December 2017 release explicitly confirms the hotel opened on 18 December after ten months converting an existing hostel. This is the MEININGER brand opening, not the first use of the building.
pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid in Milan’s Cenisio area, with private multi-bed family rooms, a guest kitchen, laundry and shared lounge spaces.

Family and budget stay

Book a whole private family room and confirm the beds, occupancy and cot needs. Shared dormitory beds are a different product. A guest kitchen, laundry and lounge can help with meals and longer stays; check equipment, charges and house rules. Compare the full room bill, breakfast, taxes, parking, storage and cancellation conditions.

The hotel is in the Cenisio area, not beside the Duomo. The operator places it about 500 metres from Cenisio on metro line M5, with tram connections nearby. Plan the actual walk, transfers and return journey with children and luggage; transport tickets are separate.

Guest feedback

Guests praise helpful staff, metro access and the kitchen. Other firsthand accounts criticize reception and kitchen-staff interactions, late-entry rules, location expectations and refund handling. These are individual experiences; confirm evening access and cancellation terms, and review the exact neighbourhood and journey before booking. Scores are a dated snapshot from 255 reviews.

Brand opening and conversion

MEININGER opened on 18 December 2017 after a ten-month conversion of a former hostel. The operator described the interiors as inspired by Milan’s public transport. This dates the brand opening rather than construction of an entirely new building.

The current operator portfolio lists 80 rooms and 268 beds, matching the opening announcement. Availability depends on the booked room and dates. No conversion-specific investment was verified.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-23: refreshed Tripadvisor UK snapshot 255 reviews, overall 3.9/5. Rooms 4.0, Service 4.0, Location 3.7, Cleanliness 4.1, Value 4.0 rounded to half steps. Iry I firsthand couple review July 2026, site-translated from Italian; exact day unknown. Reception/kitchen interactions, evening access, location and refund complaints retained. MICHELIN Milan complete 1–40 of 40 and Forbes Milan no match; AAA excludes Italy. Acclaim zero records checked-guide absence.

pin.title: Great Wolf Lodge Gurnee Grand Opening
pin.description: A family resort in Gurnee, Illinois, with suites, indoor water-park admission included with overnight stays and additional paid attractions.
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: This dates the formal Great Wolf grand-opening ceremony on 21 June 2018. Getty Images’ primary event photo 980492638 explicitly dates the button-press ceremony that day; contemporary Daily Herald and TravelPulse coverage corroborate it. Operator history separately gives July 22, 2018 as reopening, and early publicity targeted July 1. These are not used to date the observed ceremony. Daily Herald HTML metadata is offset from its displayed June 21 dateline; the independent event-photo date resolves the ceremony day.

pin.longFormSummary:
A family resort in Gurnee, Illinois, with suites, indoor water-park admission included with overnight stays and additional paid attractions.

Family water-park stay

Confirm the exact suite layout, beds and booked guests. Overnight stays include water-park admission; check hours, height restrictions, wristbands and supervision. Dining, parking, arcade games and other paid attractions add to the bill. Compare the full package and arrival-day or departure-day admission terms.

The operator lists 414 suites and an 80,000-square-foot indoor water park. Microwaves are shared in common areas, so do not assume an in-suite microwave. The resort is in Gurnee between the Chicago and Milwaukee regions; plan actual driving distances for city outings.

Guest feedback

A family visiting on March weekdays describes a smooth check-in, a room ready early and enjoyable slides with shorter queues. A November guest reports an unwanted room position, elevator congestion and heating problems. Other feedback raises cleaning and maintenance concerns. These are individual guest experiences; verify the exact suite, recent maintenance feedback and all extras. Scores are a dated snapshot.

Conversion and formal celebration

The Great Wolf grand-opening ceremony took place on 21 June 2018, with Chance the Rapper and the company CEO pressing the opening button. The event photographer’s dated record identifies this celebration of the converted former Key Lime Cove resort.

Contemporary onsite reporting quotes the CEO describing US$65 million in renovation and improvements. This is the reported conversion investment, separate from buying the property, its original construction and nightly room rates. It is not an audited final-cost breakdown.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-23: refreshed Tripadvisor UK snapshot 944 reviews, overall 3.7/5. Rooms 3.8, Service 3.8, Location 4.3, Cleanliness 3.9, Value 3.5 rounded to half steps. Jodi K firsthand family review March 2025, exact day unknown. November heating, room-position and elevator complaints plus maintenance tradeoffs retained. AAA exact 414-unit resort verified; component scores not substituted for guest scores. Forbes Chicago no match; MICHELIN Gurnee unavailable. Acclaim null.
